title: Choosing Supplies for a Drawing
context: Lena 在画材店向店员 Max 寻找适合铅笔画的纸和橡皮。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I'm looking for paper for a pencil drawing. Can you help?
dialogue.zh: 我在找适合铅笔画的纸。你能帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Of course. Do you want loose sheets or a sketchbook?
dialogue.zh: 当然。你想要单张纸还是速写本？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: A sketchbook would be easier to carry to the park.
dialogue.zh: 速写本带去公园会更方便。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: This one has thicker paper and a hard cover.
dialogue.zh: 这本纸较厚，还有硬封面。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Can I erase pencil marks without damaging the paper?
dialogue.zh: 擦掉铅笔痕迹时会弄坏纸吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: If you erase gently, this paper should hold up well.
dialogue.zh: 如果轻轻擦，这种纸应该比较耐用。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: That sounds useful. Do you have a soft eraser too?
dialogue.zh: 听起来很实用。你们也有软橡皮吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Yes, these white ones are popular for pencil work.
dialogue.zh: 有，这些白色橡皮画铅笔画的人很喜欢用。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I'll take one. Are the pencils sold separately?
dialogue.zh: 我拿一块。铅笔是单独卖的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: They are. You can try a few different ones at that table.
dialogue.zh: 是的。你可以在那张桌子旁试试几种不同的铅笔。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: I like this darker one, so I'll add it to my basket.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢这支颜色深一些的，我把它也放进篮子。

dialogue.speaker: Max
dialogue.en: Nice choice. I can ring those up at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 选得不错。我可以在柜台帮你结账。

expressions.zh: 单张纸，区别于装订成册的纸。
expressions.example: I keep loose sheets in a folder.
These shoes have held up well.
There are pencil marks on the page.
The clerk rang up my notebook.

pronunciation: sketchbook 的重音在 sketch；separately 的重音在第一个音节，注意中间音节较轻。

practice.title: Part 1 · Drawing
practice.prompt: Do you ever draw in your free time?
practice.answer: Sometimes I draw simple plants in a notebook. It helps me slow down after work.

practice.title: Part 2 · Something you made
practice.prompt: Describe something you made by hand. Say what it was, what you used, and how you felt about it.
practice.answer: I made a pencil drawing of a tree outside my window. I used a small sketchbook, a dark pencil, and a soft eraser. At first the branches looked uneven, so I erased a few lines and tried again. I spent a quiet afternoon on it and gave the finished picture to my sister. I felt pleased because I had made something personal. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Creative activities
practice.prompt: Why might adults enjoy making art even if they are beginners?
practice.answer: Art can be relaxing and offers a way to express ideas. Beginners can also enjoy seeing their skills improve without needing to produce perfect work.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后向店员说明你想画什么，询问纸和铅笔。
practice.answer: I'm looking for paper for pencil drawings. Is this sketchbook easy to carry? Can I try this pencil?
